name: optipine
description: Backtest and optimize TradingView Pine Script strategies offline, verified against TradingView's own exports.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pine/engine && npm run build --workspace @pine/messages && npm run build --workspace @pine/optimizer && npm run build --workspace @pine/market-data && npm run build --workspace @pine/workers && npm run build --workspace @pine/golden && npm run build --workspace @pine/cli && npm run build --workspace @pine/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
